capabilities.notes: Immediately after every PR into main merges, it must fail closed until canonical main fast-forwards and HEAD equals the fetched/server merge SHA. Tracked state must be clean; ordinary untracked paths are rejected, except exact registered nested-worktree roots with proved no target conflict and unchanged branch/HEAD/status. Until then no release/tag, installation, cleanup, or next merge-cycle action; it never resets, switches over changes, stashes, discards, or repairs that checkout. Installation evidence must never use a distribution channel the owning product marks blocked or unverified; an exact source-built artifact is allowed only when that product explicitly permits it, otherwise release evidence is blocked and the task remains queued. One exclusive lane owns validation, CI, release/install evidence, and cleanup.
